posts.name: Mayank Poddar
posts.cooked: 13 / 15 Questions should be attempted but I did all the 15. Will I get total of best 13 of 15 or total of first 13?

posts.name: Dibakash Baruah
posts.cooked: Ideally, it should be best 13 out of 15. I have the same question.

posts.name: Om Narayan Singh
posts.cooked: Any clarification on this? @22F3002354 . Please consider best 13 out of 15

posts.name: Yash Rastogi
posts.cooked: Yes, the marking is best 13 out of 15.

posts.name: Nishant Gupta
posts.cooked:
Their Instructions and marking systems do not match.
Neither in OPPE
Noe in ET
*Attempt any 13/15
*All ques of 8 marks
*Total capped to 100
So if any 13 attempted, and all correct, you get 100/100
Even if one question wrong, total = 96/100
If any 1 questions half right, rest all correct, total = 100
*It’s not conversion of 104 to 100 it’s capped to 100
And now, marks are provided altogether x/120 (%) ??
